notes.title: Added anti-psychedelic filter
notes.content:
Now you have the possibility to decrease the acidity of the colors in the game. This feature was requested from a few of the beta testers. So here it is. You can find it in the game options. See it in action here https://youtu.be/afk4u8uXH7E

The recommended setting are to keep it very low.
Regards
